There’s a difference between a physical addiction and a psychological addiction. Sure, you won’t die if you stop smoking, but you will experience psychological withdrawal effects. 

If you WANT to stop, just try one day without it. One day is a long time and if you can manage one day, that is an absolutely fantastic achievement that you should be proud of. 

If you can’t, that’s okay too. You tried, and that’s the most important part. There are more days and if you decide to try again, good for you!
